description: A comprehensive end-to-end project to research, procure, assemble, and tune a high-performance custom mechanical keyboard. This project covers identifying components, managing shipping logistics, assembling hardware, and configuring firmware to ensure a premium typing experience.

tasks.title: Define Build Requirements
tasks.description: Determine the desired form factor, switch type preference, and aesthetic theme. Research PCB compatibility and mounting styles to ensure all parts will fit together physically.

tasks.title: Source Components
tasks.description: Identify vendors for the PCB, plate, case, switches, stabilizers, and keycaps. Check stock levels and estimated shipping times to align with the 30-day deadline.
subtasks: Verify shipping times for international orders

tasks.title: Procurement Phase
tasks.description: Execute purchases for all components. Track shipping numbers and maintain a log of arrival dates for all packages.

tasks.title: Component Inspection
tasks.description: Once parts arrive, inspect them for physical defects or shipping damage. Test the PCB using a software keyboard tester to ensure all sockets are functional before assembly.
subtasks: Check case for scuffs or scratches

tasks.title: Stabilizer Tuning
tasks.description: Lubricate and balance the stabilizers to remove rattle and ensure a smooth key press. This step significantly improves the acoustic quality of the keyboard.
subtasks: Test balance on a flat surface

tasks.title: Switch Preparation
tasks.description: If choosing to customize, lubricate switches to enhance the feel and sound profile. This is a time-consuming process that requires precision.
subtasks: Apply lubricant to springs and stems

tasks.title: Case & PCB Assembly
tasks.description: Begin final assembly by installing the stabilizers and mounting the PCB to the plate. Carefully seat the switches into the PCB hot-swap sockets.
subtasks: Gently insert switches ensuring no bent pins

tasks.title: Firmware Configuration
tasks.description: Flash the keyboard with custom keymaps using VIA or QMK software. Set up layers for media controls, macros, and function keys.

tasks.title: Final Quality Check
tasks.description: Test every key for consistent actuation and feel. Ensure the case is tightened properly and there is no ping or uneven sound across the board.
subtasks: Check for rattling or sticking keys

summary: This workflow is structured to guide the user from initial component selection through to the physical assembly, firmware flashing, and final quality verification, ensuring all components are sourced and tested within a 30-day timeline.
